blacklistabilityReview.evidence: At Ethereum block 26224761 (2026-10-19T06:14:23Z), Ring Core 0xb2799ed78490ea642d2ecb23cb2ce9b8acc087d4 returned getRoleMemberCount(BURNER_ROLE) = 0; GOVERN_ROLE has three members: Core itself, 0xff790875de1f44d4ddc1f905a2b9cf0c11116859 and 0x9336d0c82299da0ab178271792954adfd6f10fd7. The verified AssetToken 0x4ea40dcee961675683e0a2e1721bd49cb9bca913 overrides burnFrom(account,amount) with onlyBurner and burns without allowance, and CoreRef.setCore(address) is onlyGovernor, but no burner is currently assigned. The live control is therefore the governors' ability to grant BURNER_ROLE, a direct Possible rather than an active Yes. USDR has a single Ethereum deployment holding the entire on-chain supply (totalSupply = 100,400,000 at the same block), so that deployment is material.

branchApplicability.rationale: The verified USDR AssetToken mint path accepts only an account and amount, and the reviewed Core roles expose no collateral-ratio gate, reserve-ratio input, oracle call, NAV, exchange-rate quote, or liquidation engine. At finalized Ethereum block 25531699 on 2026-07-14, the current minter set was three EOAs and RingLaunchpad; the launchpad only deploys generic tokens and seeds AMM liquidity. The PCV/bonding-curve description is not tied to a price-sensitive authority in the tracked USDR issuance path, so not-applicable remains correct.
